'''Organa Marines''' were a military unit loyal to [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:S" />

Organa Marines were deployed during the [[Alderaan Civil War]].<ref name="TOR:S" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> they landed on the banks of the [[Glarus Valley]] river to assault [[Castle Panteer]] that was held by [[House Ulgo]]. However, their objective was discovered and they were attacked by Imperial operatives allied with [[House Ulgo]] and suffered heavy casualties.<ref name="TOR:S" /> Sometime later, a troop of Organa Marines led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Elkin (marine commander)|Elkin]] joined the forces of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Linel Organa]] to fight [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] in [[King's Pass]].<ref name="TOR:WL" />
